words.enDefinition: an event where student clubs recruit new members each term

examples.en: At the clubs fair, every booth promised free pizza and fun weekly events.
examples.zh: 在「社团招新会」上，每个摊位都许诺免费披萨和有趣的周常活动。

examples.en: The international students' association stood out at the clubs fair with a lion dance.
examples.zh: 国际学生协会在「社团招新会」上表演舞狮，特别显眼。

words.enDefinition: a concentrated effort by a club to attract new members

examples.en: The debate society launched a recruitment drive during the first week of classes.
examples.zh: 辩论社在开学第一周启动了「招新活动」。

examples.en: Our recruitment drive doubled the membership compared to last spring.
examples.zh: 我们这次的「招新活动」让会员数比去年春天翻了一倍。

words.enDefinition: a booth a club staffs to meet and recruit new members

examples.en: Our recruitment table outside the dining hall drew a crowd with free stickers.
examples.zh: 我们设在食堂外的「招新摊位」用免费贴纸吸引了不少人围观。

examples.en: Two officers staff the recruitment table during every lunch hour this week.
examples.zh: 本周每个午休时段都有两名干事值守「招新摊位」。

words.enDefinition: a day when a club welcomes visitors to look around

examples.en: The drama club's open house lets newcomers tour the theater and meet current members.
examples.zh: 话剧社的「开放日」欢迎新生参观剧场并认识现任成员。

examples.en: Stop by our open house this Saturday; no experience is needed to join.
examples.zh: 周六来我们的「开放日」吧，加入不需要任何经验。

words.enDefinition: A short event where prospective members try a club activity before deciding whether to join.

examples.en: I booked a club taster session to see whether I liked playing with the orchestra.
examples.zh: 我预约了一个「社团体验活动」，看看自己是否喜欢和管弦乐团一起演奏。

examples.en: The ceramics group offered a club taster session with enough materials for twelve new students.
examples.zh: 陶艺社举办了一次「社团体验活动」，材料够十二名新生使用。

collocations: sign up for a club taster session

words.enDefinition: a first gathering for students considering joining a club

examples.en: The model UN society is holding an interest meeting in Hodson Hall tonight.
examples.zh: 模拟联合国社团今晚在霍森楼开一场「意向见面会」。

examples.en: About forty freshmen showed up to the interest meeting, way more than expected.
examples.zh: 大约有四十个大一新生来参加了「意向见面会」，比预期多得多。

words.enDefinition: a student thinking about joining a club or team

examples.en: Prospective members can attend two practices for free before paying dues.
examples.zh: 「准成员」可以先免费参加两次训练，之后再交会费。

examples.en: The officer in charge collected emails from every prospective member at the table.
examples.zh: 负责招新的干事在摊位前收集了每位「准成员」的邮箱。

words.enDefinition: a form some clubs require before admitting new members

examples.en: The consulting club reviews every club application and invites shortlisted students to interviews.
examples.zh: 咨询社要审阅每一份「社团申请」，并邀请入围的学生面试。

examples.en: I submitted my club application for the investment society a week before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我在截止日期前一周提交了投资学会的「社团申请」。

words.enDefinition: officially signing a new club up with the university

examples.en: Club registration opens in September, so our founding team must submit a constitution.
examples.zh: 「社团注册」九月开放，我们的创始团队必须提交章程。

examples.en: Without completing club registration, we cannot book rooms or request funding.
examples.zh: 没有完成「社团注册」，我们就不能订活动室或申请经费。

words.enDefinition: pay dues again to stay in a club another term

examples.en: Don't forget to renew membership before October 1 or you'll be removed from the roster.
examples.zh: 记得在10月1日前「续会籍」，否则你会被移出成员名册。

examples.en: It only takes two minutes online to renew membership for the spring term.
examples.zh: 在网上「续会籍」只要两分钟，春季学期也照旧。

words.enDefinition: a test session used to pick players for a team

examples.en: Soccer tryouts run all week, and cuts happen after Friday's scrimmage.
examples.zh: 足球「选拔」持续一周，周五练习赛后就公布名单。

examples.en: He spent the whole summer training for basketball tryouts in November.
examples.zh: 为了十一月的篮球「选拔」，他练了一整个夏天。

words.enDefinition: a short performance given to be chosen for a group

examples.en: A cappella auditions are next Tuesday; prepare one verse and one chorus.
examples.zh: 阿卡贝拉「试演选拔」定在下周二，准备一段主歌和一段副歌。

examples.en: She was nervous before her audition, but the director smiled at her song choice.
examples.zh: 「试演选拔」前她非常紧张，不过导演对她选的歌很满意。

words.enDefinition: a male social organization with chapters at many universities

examples.en: My brother joined a fraternity partly for the scholarship and study groups.
examples.zh: 我哥加入了一个「兄弟会」，一部分原因是那里有奖学金和学习小组。

examples.en: Fraternity houses on this campus host charity events every semester.
examples.zh: 校园里的「兄弟会」会所每学期都会举办慈善活动。

words.enDefinition: a female social organization with chapters at many universities

examples.en: Sorority recruitment happens in the fall and involves rounds of interviews.
examples.zh: 「姐妹会」纳新在秋季进行，要经过好几轮面试。

examples.en: Her sorority pairs older members with freshmen as study buddies.
examples.zh: 她所在的「姐妹会」安排老成员与大一新生结对学习。

words.enDefinition: a British term for a student club around a shared interest

examples.en: The Economics Society hosts a weekly talk and ends every term with a formal.
examples.zh: 经济学「社团」每周举办讲座，学期末还会办正装舞会。

examples.en: Joining two or three societies is the fastest way to make friends here.
examples.zh: 在这里加入两三个「社团」是交到朋友最快的方式。

words.enDefinition: a campaign to grow a club's paid membership

examples.en: Our spring membership drive added thirty new members to the photography club.
examples.zh: 春季「会员招募活动」为摄影社新增了三十名成员。

examples.en: The membership drive ends Friday, so we're tabling outside the library all week.
examples.zh: 「会员招募活动」周五截止，所以我们整周都在图书馆外摆摊。

words.enDefinition: the membership fee a club charges each term or year

examples.en: Club dues cover competition travel, so we keep them under twenty dollars a term.
examples.zh: 社团「会费」涵盖比赛差旅，所以我们把标准控制在每学期二十美元以内。

examples.en: Hardship waivers let students pay reduced club dues if money is tight.
examples.zh: 手头紧的学生可以申请减免部分「会费」。

words.enDefinition: a card proving you belong to a club or society

examples.en: Show your membership card at the door to get the discount rate.
examples.zh: 在门口出示「会员卡」就能享受优惠价。

examples.en: Digital membership cards live in the club app now instead of plastic ones.
examples.zh: 现在「会员卡」都是社团应用里的电子版了，不再用塑料卡。

words.enDefinition: a member who attends regularly and pays current dues

examples.en: Only active members can vote at the annual executive election.
examples.zh: 只有「正式会员」才能在年度干事选举中投票。

examples.en: She stayed an active member all four years despite her heavy course load.
examples.zh: 虽然课业繁重，她四年都保持着「正式会员」身份。

words.enDefinition: one of the people who started a club originally

examples.en: As a founding member, she still chairs the club's anniversary planning.
examples.zh: 作为「创始成员」，她至今还负责统筹社团周年庆。

examples.en: The founding members wrote the first constitution in a dorm common room.
examples.zh: 「创始成员」们当年是在宿舍公共活动室写出第一版章程的。

words.enDefinition: the official list of everyone belonging to a club

examples.en: The treasurer updates the member roster every term for the student activities office.
examples.zh: 财务每学期都会为学生活动办公室更新「成员名册」。

examples.en: New recruits are added to the member roster once their dues clear.
examples.zh: 新人交清会费后就会被记入「成员名册」。

words.enDefinition: the elected student who leads a club for a term

examples.en: The club president runs the weekly meeting and signs off on every budget request.
examples.zh: 「社长」主持每周例会，并在每份预算申请上签字。

examples.en: Our club president negotiated free practice space with the athletics office.
examples.zh: 我们的「社长」与体育办公室谈下了免费训练场地。

words.enDefinition: the officer who steps in when the president is away

examples.en: The vice president chaired the meeting while the president was at a conference.
examples.zh: 社长外出参会期间，例会由「副社长」代为主持。

examples.en: As vice president, she oversees recruitment and the new member mentoring program.
examples.zh: 作为「副社长」，她负责招新和新成员带教项目。

words.enDefinition: the officer who manages a club's money and records

examples.en: The club treasurer keeps receipts for everything we buy for events.
examples.zh: 社团「财务」会保存活动采买的所有收据。

examples.en: Our club treasurer flagged food spending as over budget already by October.
examples.zh: 到十月，我们的「财务」就发现餐饮开销超了预算。

words.enDefinition: the officer who takes minutes and handles club correspondence

examples.en: The club secretary emails the minutes to everyone within a day of each meeting.
examples.zh: 「社团秘书」会在每次开会后一天内把记录邮件发给大家。

examples.en: As club secretary, Priya books rooms and keeps the shared calendar updated.
examples.zh: 作为「社团秘书」，Priya 负责订教室并更新共享日历。

words.enDefinition: the small team of officers who run a club

examples.en: The executive board meets Sundays to plan events before the general meeting.
examples.zh: 「干事会」每周日碰头，在全体大会前敲定活动安排。

examples.en: Any spending over fifty dollars needs approval from the executive board.
examples.zh: 超过五十美元的支出都要经「干事会」批准。

words.enDefinition: an elected student holding a leadership role in a club

examples.en: Every club officer must complete a short training from the student activities office.
examples.zh: 每位「社团干事」都要完成学生活动办公室的简短培训。

examples.en: Each club officer handles tasks like booking rooms, social media, and welcoming new members.
examples.zh: 每位「社团干事」分别负责订教室、运营社媒或迎接新成员。

words.enDefinition: a professor who guides a club and signs official forms

examples.en: Our faculty advisor helped us negotiate funding with the student government.
examples.zh: 我们的「指导老师」帮我们向学生自治会争取到了经费。

examples.en: The university requires every registered club to have a faculty advisor.
examples.zh: 学校要求每个注册社团都要有一名「指导老师」。

words.enDefinition: the officer who plans mixers, formals, and fun events

examples.en: The social chair booked a rooftop venue for the spring formal.
examples.zh: 「文娱负责人」为春季舞会订到了一个屋顶场地。

examples.en: As social chair, he plans game nights and one big mixer each term.
examples.zh: 作为「文娱负责人」，他每学期策划游戏之夜和一场大型联谊。

words.enDefinition: the officer who organizes events that raise money for a club

examples.en: The fundraising chair scheduled the bake sale for the busiest day on campus.
examples.zh: 「筹款负责人」把义卖安排在了校园人流量最大的一天。

examples.en: Under our fundraising chair, the club covered travel costs for the whole team.
examples.zh: 在「筹款负责人」的努力下，社团为全队支付了差旅费。

words.enDefinition: the player who leads and organizes a sports team

examples.en: The team captain schedules scrimmages and reminds everyone about practice times.
examples.zh: 「队长」负责约练习赛，并提醒大家训练时间。

examples.en: Our team captain votes on rule changes at the intramural league meeting.
examples.zh: 我们的「队长」在校内联赛会议上参与修改规则的投票。

words.enDefinition: a group that organizes the details of club events

examples.en: The event planning committee meets Tuesdays to divide tasks for culture night.
examples.zh: 「活动策划委员会」每周二开会，为文化之夜分配任务。

examples.en: Join the event planning committee if you like logistics, budgets, and checklists.
examples.zh: 如果你喜欢统筹、预算和清单，就加入「活动策划委员会」吧。

words.enDefinition: the annual vote that chooses next year's club officers

examples.en: The executive election happens at the last general meeting of the spring term.
examples.zh: 「干事选举」在春季学期最后一次全体大会上进行。

examples.en: Candidates for the executive election each get three minutes to speak.
examples.zh: 参加「干事选举」的候选人每人有三分钟发言时间。

words.enDefinition: to officially try to become a club officer

examples.en: Sophomores can run for office if they've been active members for a year.
examples.zh: 大二学生只要当过一年正式会员，就可以「竞选职位」。

examples.en: She decided to run for office after leading the fundraiser committee.
examples.zh: 带完筹款小组后，她决定「竞选职位」。

words.enDefinition: to promote yourself before a club election with posters and talks

examples.en: To campaign for a position, he made posters and chatted with members after practice.
examples.zh: 为了「竞选造势」，他做了海报，训练后还挨个找成员聊天。

examples.en: Candidates may campaign for a position only during the official election week.
examples.zh: 候选人只能在正式的选举周内「竞选造势」。

words.enDefinition: a short talk explaining why you deserve a club role

examples.en: Keep your election speech under three minutes and mention one concrete plan.
examples.zh: 「竞选演讲」要控制在三分钟以内，并提到一个具体计划。

examples.en: Her election speech about weekend volunteering trips won over the room.
examples.zh: 她那段关于周末志愿行程的「竞选演讲」打动了全场。

words.enDefinition: a form used to officially put someone up for a role

examples.en: Download the nomination form from the club website and get one member signature.
examples.zh: 从社团网站下载「提名表」，并找一名成员签名。

examples.en: Nominations close Friday, so submit your nomination form to the secretary by then.
examples.zh: 提名周五截止，记得在那之前把「提名表」交给秘书。

words.enDefinition: the fixed period an elected officer serves a club

examples.en: The term of office runs from May until the following April.
examples.zh: 「任期」从五月持续到次年四月。

examples.en: Each officer serves a one-year term of office before stepping down.
examples.zh: 每位干事担任一届「任期」后就会卸任。

words.enDefinition: handing over files, passwords, and duties to new officers

examples.en: We schedule officer transition dinners so outgoing leaders can advise the incoming team.
examples.zh: 我们会安排「干事换届」聚餐，让离任负责人向新团队传授经验。

examples.en: A smooth officer transition keeps the club from losing institutional knowledge.
examples.zh: 顺利的「干事换届」能避免社团流失经验。

words.enDefinition: a regular gathering a club holds every week

examples.en: Our weekly meeting is Thursdays at seven in the student union lounge.
examples.zh: 我们的「每周例会」在周四晚七点，学生会休息室见。

examples.en: Attendance at the weekly meeting counts toward your service hour requirement.
examples.zh: 「每周例会」的出勤会计入你的服务时长要求。

words.enDefinition: a meeting all members attend to vote on big decisions

examples.en: The budget for next year is approved at the fall general meeting.
examples.zh: 明年的预算将在秋季「全体大会」上表决。

examples.en: Constitution changes require a two-thirds majority at a general meeting.
examples.zh: 修改章程需要在「全体大会」上拿到三分之二多数同意。

words.enDefinition: a room on campus reserved for a club's own use

examples.en: The clubroom doubles as a practice space with our keyboard and music stands.
examples.zh: 「社团活动室」里放着我们的电子琴和谱架，也能当练习室用。

examples.en: Keys to the clubroom are held by the secretary and the president.
examples.zh: 「社团活动室」的钥匙由社长和秘书保管。

words.enDefinition: a short summary of decisions sent to members after meetings

examples.en: The secretary sends a meeting recap so absent members know what was decided.
examples.zh: 秘书会发一份「会议回顾」，让缺席成员了解会议决定。

examples.en: Read the meeting recap in the newsletter before voting on the venue.
examples.zh: 投票选场地前，先看看通讯里的「会议回顾」。

words.enDefinition: one listed topic discussed during a club meeting

examples.en: Add your agenda item by Tuesday so the chair can order the discussion.
examples.zh: 周二前把你的「议程项目」报上来，方便主持人安排讨论顺序。

examples.en: The longest agenda item was the dispute over unbudgeted banner spending.
examples.zh: 耗时最长的「议程项目」是关于超预算买横幅的争论。

words.enDefinition: the minimum members present needed for official club votes

examples.en: We can't vote on the budget tonight because we don't have a quorum.
examples.zh: 今晚到会人数不够「法定人数」，预算没法表决。

examples.en: The constitution sets quorum at one third of active members.
examples.zh: 章程规定「法定人数」为正式会员的三分之一。

words.enDefinition: the document stating a club's purpose, roles, and rules

examples.en: Amendments to the club constitution need a two-thirds vote at a general meeting.
examples.zh: 修改「社团章程」需要在全体大会上获得三分之二票数。

examples.en: New clubs must submit a constitution before the university grants them funding.
examples.zh: 新社团必须先提交「章程」，学校才会批经费。

words.enDefinition: detailed club rules covering elections, dues, and member duties

examples.en: Our bylaws spell out exactly how vacancies on the board are filled.
examples.zh: 我们的「章程细则」明确规定了理事会职位空缺如何补选。

examples.en: The committee checked the bylaws carefully before scheduling the spring election.
examples.zh: 委员会在安排春季选举前仔细核对了「章程细则」。

words.enDefinition: a record where volunteers log their community service hours

examples.en: Volunteers enter every shift into the service log for verification at graduation.
examples.zh: 志愿者要把每个班次录入「服务时长记录表」，毕业核验时要用。

examples.en: The coordinator audits the service log monthly to catch missing signatures.
examples.zh: 负责人每月核查一次「服务时长记录表」，以防漏签。

words.enDefinition: an email list a club uses for official announcements

examples.en: Join the mailing list to receive rehearsal notes and event invitations each week.
examples.zh: 加入「邮件列表」，每周接收排练通知和活动邀请。

examples.en: She manages the mailing list and prunes addresses that bounce twice.
examples.zh: 她负责管理「邮件列表」，并清退两次退信的地址。

collocations: add members to the mailing list

words.enDefinition: a regular email update about a club's news and events

examples.en: Our monthly newsletter lists upcoming volunteer shifts and photos from past events.
examples.zh: 我们的月度「社团通讯」会列出志愿班次和以往活动的照片。

examples.en: Subscribe to the newsletter so you don't miss the early-bird formal tickets.
examples.zh: 订阅「社团通讯」，别错过舞会早鸟票。

words.enDefinition: a plan for how a club will spend its money

examples.en: The club budget allocates most funds to competition fees and travel.
examples.zh: 社团「预算」的大部分经费用于比赛报名费和差旅。

examples.en: We drafted the club budget together and submitted it to student government.
examples.zh: 我们一起起草了「社团预算」并提交给了学生自治会。

words.enDefinition: a reduction in the money a club receives for the year

examples.en: The budget cut forced our club to cancel the interstate tournament trip.
examples.zh: 「预算削减」迫使社团取消了跨州锦标赛之行。

examples.en: Officers appealed the budget cut by showing attendance records from last year.
examples.zh: 干事们出示去年的出勤记录，对「预算削减」提出申诉。

words.enDefinition: a formal ask for money from student government or the university

examples.en: The funding request covered venue rental for our charity concert.
examples.zh: 这份「经费申请」涵盖了慈善音乐会的场地租金。

examples.en: Funding requests are reviewed monthly, so plan your event timeline backwards.
examples.zh: 「经费申请」每月集中审批一次，活动日程要倒着排。

words.enDefinition: a per-student fee that funds clubs and campus events

examples.en: Part of every student activity fee goes back to registered clubs like ours.
examples.zh: 每份「学生活动费」中都有一部分会拨给像我们这样的注册社团。

examples.en: The activity fee committee decides how the student activity fee is split each year.
examples.zh: 活动费委员会决定每年「学生活动费」如何分配。

words.enDefinition: a form that lets officers get paid back for purchases

examples.en: Attach every receipt to the reimbursement form or the treasurer will return it.
examples.zh: 所有收据都要附在「报销单」上，否则财务会退回。

examples.en: Submit the reimbursement form within two weeks or the claim expires.
examples.zh: 「报销单」要在两周内提交，过期就报不了了。

words.enDefinition: an event organized to raise money for a club or cause

examples.en: Our car wash fundraiser paid for new jerseys for the whole intramural team.
examples.zh: 我们的洗车「筹款活动」为整支校内球队换了新队服。

examples.en: The fundraiser brought in six hundred dollars, double what we hoped for.
examples.zh: 这次「筹款活动」进账六百美元，是预期的两倍。

words.enDefinition: a club whose members do community service projects together

examples.en: The volunteer club runs a weekend tutoring program at the public library.
examples.zh: 志愿者社团在市立图书馆运营周末「辅导项目」。

examples.en: Joining a volunteer club is an easy way to earn service hours.
examples.zh: 加入「志愿者社团」是攒服务时长的简单途径。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled block of time spent volunteering at an event

examples.en: I took the Saturday morning volunteer shift at the campus food pantry.
examples.zh: 我领了周六上午在校园食物分发站的「志愿班次」。

examples.en: Sign-up for volunteer shifts opens Monday, and popular slots fill within hours.
examples.zh: 「志愿班次」周一开放报名，热门时段几小时就满了。

collocations: sign up for a volunteer shift

words.enDefinition: logged time spent volunteering that some programs require

examples.en: Volunteering at the shelter counts toward your community service hours for graduation.
examples.zh: 在收容所做志愿可以计入毕业要求的「社区服务时长」。

examples.en: She logged fifty community service hours with the tutoring club this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期她通过辅导社团攒了五十小时「社区服务时长」。

words.enDefinition: an organized activity where members help the local community

examples.en: This month's service project is repainting the community center's reading room.
examples.zh: 这个月的「志愿服务项目」是粉刷社区中心的阅览室。

examples.en: Each semester ends with a service project the whole club joins.
examples.zh: 每学期都以一个人人参与的「服务项目」收尾。

words.enDefinition: a charity kitchen serving free meals to people in need

examples.en: Our club serves lunch at the neighborhood soup kitchen every first Sunday.
examples.zh: 我们社团每月第一个周日都在社区「救济厨房」帮忙打饭。

examples.en: Volunteering at a soup kitchen counts double hours during exam weeks.
examples.zh: 考试周在「救济厨房」做志愿可以记双倍时长。

collocations: serve meals at the soup kitchen

words.enDefinition: a collection event that gathers canned food for charity

examples.en: The residence halls compete to collect the most cans during the food drive.
examples.zh: 「食品募捐」期间，各宿舍楼比赛谁收的罐头多。

examples.en: Our food drive filled three crates for the neighborhood pantry.
examples.zh: 我们的「食品募捐」给社区食物站装满了三个箱子。

words.enDefinition: an event where students can donate blood on campus

examples.en: The pre-med society volunteers as escorts at each campus blood drive.
examples.zh: 每场校园「献血活动」，预医学社都会去做引导志愿者。

examples.en: Book a slot online if you want to donate at Tuesday's blood drive.
examples.zh: 想在周二的「献血活动」献血，可以网上预约时段。

words.enDefinition: selling homemade baked goods to raise money for a club

examples.en: The bake sale table outside the library sold out by two o'clock.
examples.zh: 图书馆外的「烘焙义卖」摊位两点前就卖光了。

examples.en: For the bake sale, we need thirty dozen cookies from volunteer bakers.
examples.zh: 这次「烘焙义卖」需要志愿者提供三十打饼干。

words.enDefinition: a fun run where entry fees support a charitable cause

examples.en: Our club mans the water station at the city's annual charity run.
examples.zh: 城市年度「慈善跑」的水站由我们社团负责。

examples.en: Training together made the five-kilometer charity run feel easy this year.
examples.zh: 一起训练之后，今年五公里的「慈善跑」轻松多了。

collocations: sign up for a charity run

words.enDefinition: a club activity pairing volunteers with students who need academic help

examples.en: The tutoring program pairs education majors with middle schoolers needing math help.
examples.zh: 「辅导项目」把教育专业的志愿者与需要数学辅导的中学生配对。

examples.en: Volunteers in the tutoring program commit to one hour every Wednesday.
examples.zh: 「辅导项目」的志愿者每周三要投入一小时。

words.enDefinition: a fellow member paired with you for revision and support

examples.en: New members get a study buddy before the first midterm each fall.
examples.zh: 每年秋天第一次期中考前，新成员都会配到一名「学习搭档」。

examples.en: My study buddy and I review lecture slides together every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我和「学习搭档」每周日一起过一遍讲义幻灯片。

collocations: pair up with a study buddy

words.enDefinition: a student who represents a club or brand on campus

examples.en: Campus ambassadors host table events and answer questions from interested students.
examples.zh: 「校园大使」负责摆摊宣传，并解答感兴趣同学的问题。

examples.en: She became a campus ambassador for the debate league after nationals.
examples.zh: 全国赛结束后，她成了辩论联盟的「校园大使」。

collocations: apply to be a campus ambassador

words.enDefinition: the annual fall celebration welcoming alumni back to campus

examples.en: The whole club marches in the homecoming parade wearing our custom jerseys.
examples.zh: 整个社团穿着定制队服参加「返校节」游行。

examples.en: We sell baked goods at the homecoming tailgate to fund our season.
examples.zh: 我们在「返校节」车尾野餐会上卖烘焙点心，为赛季筹款。

words.enDefinition: a casual social event where members meet people from other clubs

examples.en: The engineering society's fall mixer is the best place to find project partners.
examples.zh: 工程学会的秋季「联谊会」是找项目搭档的最佳场合。

examples.en: Our mixer with the business society features trivia and free pizza.
examples.zh: 我们和商科社团的「联谊会」有问答游戏和免费披萨。

words.enDefinition: a dress-up dance party a club throws near year's end

examples.en: Tickets for the spring formal sell out within a week every April.
examples.zh: 每年四月，「春季舞会」的门票一周内就售罄。

examples.en: The spring formal included a photo corner and a small awards ceremony.
examples.zh: 「春季舞会」还设了拍照角和小型颁奖环节。

words.enDefinition: a formal dinner where a club celebrates the year's achievements

examples.en: At the end-of-year banquet, seniors receive certificates and share farewell speeches.
examples.zh: 在「年终晚宴」上，毕业生领证书并发表告别演讲。

examples.en: This year's end-of-year banquet doubled as our officer transition ceremony.
examples.zh: 今年的「年终晚宴」同时充当了干事换届仪式。

words.enDefinition: light food and drinks provided at club events

examples.en: The club budget covers refreshments for every general meeting we hold.
examples.zh: 社团预算为每次全体大会都提供「茶点」。

examples.en: Refreshments will be served in the clubroom after the guest panel.
examples.zh: 嘉宾座谈结束后，「茶点」将在社团活动室供应。

words.enDefinition: a relaxed evening of board games and snacks with the club

examples.en: Game night Fridays are how our club unwinds after competition season.
examples.zh: 周五的「游戏之夜」是我们赛季结束后放松的方式。

examples.en: Bring your favorite board game to game night in the clubroom.
examples.zh: 带上你最喜欢的桌游来活动室参加「游戏之夜」吧。

words.enDefinition: a social evening where members sing songs together for fun

examples.en: The cultural society's karaoke night always ends with a full-cast group song.
examples.zh: 文化社团的「卡拉OK之夜」总以全员合唱收尾。

examples.en: I warmed up my voice before karaoke night so I wouldn't croak.
examples.zh: 「卡拉OK之夜」前我先练了练嗓子，免得唱劈。

words.enDefinition: a shared meal a sports team holds before big games

examples.en: The team dinner before the championship is a pasta night at our captain's place.
examples.zh: 锦标赛前的「队内聚餐」是队长家的意面之夜。

examples.en: Coach cancelled practice so we could make the team dinner on time.
examples.zh: 教练取消了训练，好让我们准时赶上「队内聚餐」。

words.enDefinition: a game or exercise that helps members trust and cooperate

examples.en: Each retreat opens with team-building activities so new and old members mix quickly.
examples.zh: 每次休整营都以「团建活动」开场，让新老成员迅速熟络。

examples.en: The escape room team-building activity revealed who the natural planners were.
examples.zh: 密室逃脱这种「团建活动」最能看出谁天生擅长统筹。

words.enDefinition: the stated clothing expectations for an event or club

examples.en: The spring formal dress code is business casual, no jeans or sneakers.
examples.zh: 春季舞会的「着装要求」是商务休闲，不要牛仔裤和运动鞋。

examples.en: Cultural attire is always welcome, whatever the dress code says.
examples.zh: 无论「着装要求」怎么写，民族服饰一律欢迎。

words.enDefinition: a large sign greeting visitors at a club event

examples.en: The welcome sign at the fair listed our meeting times and QR code.
examples.zh: 招新会上的「迎宾指示牌」写着我们的活动时间和二维码。

examples.en: Volunteers repainted the welcome sign on the clubroom door this weekend.
examples.zh: 志愿者周末把社团活动室门上的「迎宾牌」重新画了一遍。

words.enDefinition: a ticket drawing at an event where winners get prizes

examples.en: The fundraiser raffle offers prizes donated by local restaurants and shops.
examples.zh: 筹款「抽奖」的奖品由本地餐馆和商铺捐赠。

examples.en: Buy three raffle tickets for five dollars; proceeds fund our service trip.
examples.zh: 「抽奖券」三张五美元，收入用于我们的公益之旅。

words.enDefinition: a student singing group that performs without instruments

examples.en: Our a cappella group opens every show with a beatbox-heavy arrangement.
examples.zh: 我们的「阿卡贝拉团」每场演出都以重鼓点改编开场。

examples.en: She joined the a cappella group after two years of high school choir.
examples.zh: 中学合唱两年后，她加入了「阿卡贝拉团」。

collocations: audition for the a cappella group

words.enDefinition: a long speech performed by one actor in an audition

examples.en: Prepare a two-minute monologue for the drama club audition next Friday.
examples.zh: 下周五话剧社选拔，请准备一段两分钟的「独白」。

examples.en: Her comedic monologue about cafeteria food got laughs from the whole panel.
examples.zh: 她那段吐槽食堂的喜剧「独白」逗笑了整个评审组。

words.enDefinition: the students who handle sets, lights, and sound for shows

examples.en: Join the stage crew if you'd rather build sets than perform on them.
examples.zh: 如果你更想搭布景而不是登台，就来加入「舞台工作组」。

examples.en: The stage crew arrives three hours early to test lights and microphones.
examples.zh: 「舞台组」提前三小时到场调试灯光和麦克风。

words.enDefinition: the final full practice performed exactly like the real show

examples.en: Dress rehearsal runs Friday evening; costumes, lights, and full makeup required.
examples.zh: 「带妆彩排」周五晚上进行，要备好服装、灯光和全套妆造。

examples.en: We fixed the sound cues at dress rehearsal, so opening night went smoothly.
examples.zh: 我们在「彩排」时修好了音效提示，首演之夜一切顺利。

words.enDefinition: unscripted comedy scenes made up on the spot by players

examples.en: The improv club practices Tuesdays and hosts a show every month.
examples.zh: 「即兴表演」社每周二练习，每月办一场演出。

examples.en: Improv taught me to stay calm when a presentation goes off script.
examples.zh: 「即兴表演」教会我在演讲脱稿时保持镇定。

words.enDefinition: a large band that plays while marching at sports events

examples.en: Marching band camp starts a week before classes with eight-hour outdoor rehearsals.
examples.zh: 「行进管乐队」集训在开学前一周开始，每天户外排练八小时。

examples.en: The marching band performs at every home game, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 无论风雨，每场主场比赛「行进管乐队」都会登台演出。

words.enDefinition: a large student ensemble with strings, winds, and percussion

examples.en: The university orchestra holds seating auditions at the start of each year.
examples.zh: 大学「管弦乐团」在每学年初进行席位选拔。

examples.en: Our orchestra collaborates with the choir for a winter concert every December.
examples.zh: 每年十二月，「管弦乐团」都会与合唱团合作冬季音乐会。

words.enDefinition: a group that sings together, often in parts, at concerts

examples.en: Choir rehearsals are Tuesdays and Thursdays, with extra sectionals before concerts.
examples.zh: 「合唱团」周二周四排练，音乐会前还有分声部加练。

examples.en: No audition is required for the community choir, just regular attendance.
examples.zh: 社区「合唱团」不用选拔，保证出勤就行。

words.enDefinition: a student team performing choreographed routines at campus events

examples.en: The dance crew holds open workshops before auditions so beginners can learn combos.
examples.zh: 「舞蹈队」在选拔前开设公开工作坊，带新手学动作组合。

examples.en: Our dance crew won the inter-university showcase with a hip-hop medley.
examples.zh: 我们「舞蹈队」凭一段嘻哈串烧拿下校际展演冠军。

words.enDefinition: an event where students perform singing, dancing, or comedy acts

examples.en: The international society's talent show is the highlight of culture week.
examples.zh: 国际学生社团的「才艺表演会」是文化周的高光环节。

examples.en: Sign up for a three-minute slot at the talent show by Friday.
examples.zh: 想上「才艺表演会」，周五前报名三分钟的节目档。

words.enDefinition: a casual event where anyone can perform a short set

examples.en: The poetry club's open mic welcomes first-time readers as warmly as veterans.
examples.zh: 诗歌社的「开放麦」对新人和老手同样欢迎。

examples.en: He tested new material at the open mic before the comedy competition.
examples.zh: 喜剧比赛前，他在「开放麦」上试了新段子。

collocations: sign up for the open mic

words.enDefinition: a student club celebrating one culture's food, arts, and traditions

examples.en: The Filipino cultural society hosts adobo cooking workshops every semester.
examples.zh: 菲律宾「文化社团」每学期都办阿多波烹饪工作坊。

examples.en: Cultural societies often collaborate for the big spring festival on the quad.
examples.zh: 各「文化社团」经常合作，在中央草坪办春季大型节庆。

words.enDefinition: a showcase evening of food, dance, and fashion from one culture

examples.en: Culture night sold four hundred tickets and featured twelve student performances.
examples.zh: 「文化之夜」卖出四百张票，呈现了十二个学生节目。

examples.en: I modeled traditional dress for the first time at culture night.
examples.zh: 我第一次在「文化之夜」上展示传统服饰。

words.enDefinition: a large campus event where many clubs share their cultures

examples.en: The spring cultural festival fills the quad with food stalls and performances.
examples.zh: 春季「文化节」让中央草坪摆满美食摊和演出舞台。

examples.en: Our cultural festival booth offered calligraphy and free milk tea samples.
examples.zh: 我们「文化节」摊位提供书法体验和免费奶茶试喝。

words.enDefinition: a student organization for shared religious practice and discussion

examples.en: Faith groups on campus often provide free Friday dinners and discussion circles.
examples.zh: 校园里的「信仰社团」常在周五提供免费晚餐和交流小组。

examples.en: Her faith group organized a weekend service trip to the coastal town.
examples.zh: 她的「信仰社团」组织了去海滨小镇的周末服务之旅。

words.enDefinition: an evening event showcasing food and acts from many cultures

examples.en: International night filled the auditorium with food stalls from twelve societies.
examples.zh: 「国际之夜」让礼堂里摆满了十二个社团的美食摊。

examples.en: Our dance crew rehearses twice a week for international night.
examples.zh: 我们舞蹈队为「国际之夜」每周排练两次。

words.enDefinition: a weekly drop-in hour for practicing casual conversation

examples.en: The language society hosts a conversation hour for Mandarin learners on Wednesdays.
examples.zh: 语言社团每周三为中文学习者举办一场「会话角」。

examples.en: I volunteer at the conversation hour to help newcomers practice small talk.
examples.zh: 我在「会话角」做志愿者，帮新生练习日常寒暄。

collocations: drop in at the conversation hour

words.enDefinition: a casual sports league played between campus teams, not other schools

examples.en: Our intramural league has divisions for every skill level, including total beginners.
examples.zh: 我们的「校内联赛」按水平分组，纯新手也有组别。

examples.en: The intramural league champions get cheap t-shirts and eternal bragging rights.
examples.zh: 「校内联赛」冠军只能拿到便宜T恤和永远的吹牛资本。

words.enDefinition: the official university team that competes against other schools

examples.en: Playing for a varsity team means year-round training and travel schedules.
examples.zh: 进「校队」意味着全年训练和出行日程。

examples.en: She balanced engineering coursework with varsity team commitments every fall.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，她都要在工程课业和「校队」任务之间找平衡。

words.enDefinition: a student-run sports team more serious than intramurals but not varsity

examples.en: Club sports travel to weekend tournaments but leave scheduling to student officers.
examples.zh: 「体育社团」会去外地打周末锦标赛，但日程由学生干事安排。

examples.en: I joined the club sport volleyball team because varsity tryouts felt too intense.
examples.zh: 我加入了排球「体育社团」，因为校队选拔太卷了。

words.enDefinition: a low-stakes practice game between members of the same club

examples.en: Saturday scrimmages let new players test skills before the season starts.
examples.zh: 周六的「练习赛」让新人在赛季开始前检验技术。

examples.en: We ran a scrimmage against the second team to try new formations.
examples.zh: 我们和二队打了一场「练习赛」，试验新阵型。

words.enDefinition: a match played at the team's own campus venue

examples.en: The club paints faces for every home game to boost attendance.
examples.zh: 每场「主场比赛」社团都会帮忙画脸彩，吸引观众。

examples.en: Home games are free for students who show their university ID.
examples.zh: 学生出示校园卡就能免费看「主场比赛」。

collocations: first home game of the season

words.enDefinition: the knockout rounds that decide a league's season winner

examples.en: One more win would have sent us to the playoff bracket.
examples.zh: 再赢一场，我们就能进「季后赛」对阵表了。

examples.en: The intramural playoff schedule is posted the week before final exams.
examples.zh: 「季后赛」赛程表在期末考前一周公布。

words.enDefinition: a cup awarded to the winner of a club competition

examples.en: The intramural trophy sits in the clubroom window for everyone to see.
examples.zh: 校内联赛「奖杯」摆在社团活动室窗边，人人可见。

examples.en: We engraved last season's trophy with every member's name after the final.
examples.zh: 决赛后我们把每位成员的名字都刻在了上个赛季的「奖杯」上。

words.enDefinition: the elected body representing students to the university administration

examples.en: Student government allocates the activity fee budget among registered clubs.
examples.zh: 「学生自治会」负责在注册社团间分配活动费预算。

examples.en: She ran for student government to improve funding for small clubs.
examples.zh: 她竞选「学生自治会」，想为小社团争取更多经费。

words.enDefinition: a smaller elected council handling campus student affairs and events

examples.en: The student council organizes the winter ball and the club awards night.
examples.zh: 「学生会」负责组织冬季舞会和社团颁奖之夜。

examples.en: Student council meetings are open, so any student can raise a concern.
examples.zh: 「学生会」会议对所有人开放，任何学生都能提出关切。

words.enDefinition: a student elected to voice their class's concerns to faculty

examples.en: As class representative, she relayed exam scheduling complaints to the department.
examples.zh: 作为「班级代表」，她把考试排期问题反馈给了系里。

examples.en: Class representatives meet the dean once a month with collected feedback.
examples.zh: 「班级代表」每月带着汇总意见与院长见一次面。

words.enDefinition: an elected student who votes in the campus senate

examples.en: Student senators debated a new funding formula for three meetings straight.
examples.zh: 「学生参议员」们连续三次会议都在辩论新的经费分配方案。

examples.en: Each college of the university elects two student senators annually.
examples.zh: 学校每个学院每年选出两名「学生参议员」。

words.enDefinition: a signed request asking the university or council to change something

examples.en: Our petition for longer library hours gathered eight hundred signatures in one week.
examples.zh: 我们要求延长图书馆开放时间的「请愿书」一周就收集了八百个签名。

examples.en: The council debated the petition at its next public meeting.
examples.zh: 学生会在下次公开会议上讨论了这份「请愿书」。

words.enDefinition: a club that campaigns for causes like sustainability or accessibility

examples.en: The sustainability advocacy group pushed the dining hall to compost food waste.
examples.zh: 可持续发展「倡议团体」推动食堂把厨余做成堆肥。

examples.en: Our advocacy group tables with petitions during welcome week every September.
examples.zh: 每年九月迎新周，我们的「倡议团体」都摆摊征集请愿签名。

words.enDefinition: a campus branch of a national professional or honor society

examples.en: Our student chapter of the engineering society sends delegates to the national conference.
examples.zh: 我们工程学会的「学生分会」派代表参加全国大会。

examples.en: Starting a student chapter gives you access to the society's journals and mentors.
examples.zh: 建立「学生分会」就能使用学会的期刊和导师资源。

words.enDefinition: the regular meeting of a local branch of a society

examples.en: Chapter meetings follow a national agenda template, then add campus business.
examples.zh: 「分会例会」按全国统一的议程模板进行，再补充校区事务。

examples.en: Our chapter meeting includes a guest talk from a local engineer.
examples.zh: 我们的「分会例会」会请本地工程师做嘉宾分享。

words.enDefinition: a gathering where chapters from nearby schools meet and compete

examples.en: At the regional conference, our delegation presented the campus food recovery project.
examples.zh: 在「地区会议」上，我们代表团介绍了校园食物回收项目。

examples.en: The regional conference mixes workshops, awards, and networking dinners for delegates.
examples.zh: 「地区会议」为代表们安排了工作坊、颁奖和社交晚宴。

words.enDefinition: former members who stay connected and help current students

examples.en: The club's alumni network helped seniors land internships through referrals.
examples.zh: 社团的「校友网络」靠内推帮毕业生找到实习。

examples.en: Alumni network events pair current members with graduates in their fields.
examples.zh: 「校友网络」活动会让在读成员与相关领域毕业生结对。

words.enDefinition: a structured event where students meet professionals and peers

examples.en: The finance society's networking event connects members with local firm recruiters.
examples.zh: 金融社团的「人脉拓展活动」让成员对接本地公司招聘官。

examples.en: Bring business cards and two questions to every networking event you attend.
examples.zh: 参加每场「人脉拓展活动」都带上名片和两个问题。

words.enDefinition: an organization serving a public cause rather than making profit

examples.en: Our club partners with a local nonprofit that refurbishes laptops for schools.
examples.zh: 我们社团与一家本地「非营利组织」合作，为学校翻新旧笔记本电脑。

examples.en: Nonprofits often recruit volunteers directly from campus clubs each September.
examples.zh: 每年九月，「非营利组织」常直接来校园社团招志愿者。

words.enDefinition: any organized student activity outside regular coursework

examples.en: Clubs, intramurals, and student government all count as extracurricular activities.
examples.zh: 社团、校内联赛和学生自治会都算「课外活动」。

examples.en: Resume reviewers like to see one extracurricular activity with real leadership responsibility.
examples.zh: 简历评审更想看到一段有真实领导职责的「课外活动」。

words.enDefinition: to found a new registered student organization on campus

examples.en: To start a club, you need five members, a constitution, and a faculty advisor.
examples.zh: 「创建社团」需要五名成员、一份章程和一位指导老师。

examples.en: She decided to start a club for board game design after transfer week.
examples.zh: 转学周过后，她决定和朋友「创建社团」，专注桌游设计。

words.enDefinition: a printed shirt that shows club membership and spirit

examples.en: Wear your club t-shirt to the fair so prospective members can spot us.
examples.zh: 招新会那天穿上「社团文化衫」，准成员一眼就能认出我们。

examples.en: The new club t-shirt design won a vote at the general meeting.
examples.zh: 新版「文化衫」设计在全体大会上投票胜出。

words.enDefinition: booking a campus room for meetings or club events

examples.en: Room reservations for the clubroom open two weeks in advance on the portal.
examples.zh: 「活动室预订」在系统上提前两周开放。

examples.en: Our room reservation got bumped because a department needed the space.
examples.zh: 我们的「活动室预订」被顶掉了，因为某院系要用那个场地。

words.enDefinition: the volunteers who arrange chairs, tables, and gear before an event

examples.en: The setup crew arrives ninety minutes before doors to arrange chairs and banners.
examples.zh: 「布场小组」在开门前九十分钟到场，摆好桌椅和横幅。

examples.en: Volunteers can choose between the setup crew and the cleanup team.
examples.zh: 志愿者可以在「布场小组」和收尾小组之间选一班。

words.enDefinition: a discussion event where former members answer current questions

examples.en: The alumni panel shared honest advice about internships and first jobs.
examples.zh: 「校友座谈」上，学长学姐分享了关于实习和首份工作的实在建议。

examples.en: Submit a question for the alumni panel by Friday through the club email.
examples.zh: 周五前通过社团邮箱给「校友座谈」提交问题。

words.enDefinition: how much time and effort a club expects from members

examples.en: Ask about the commitment level before joining; some teams practice daily.
examples.zh: 加入前先问清「投入程度」，有些队伍每天都要训练。

examples.en: The recruitment flyer states a medium commitment level of five hours weekly.
examples.zh: 招新传单写明「投入程度」中等，每周五小时。

words.enDefinition: the amount of practice or meeting time a club expects

examples.en: Ask about the time commitment before joining, since some teams train daily.
examples.zh: 加入前先问清「时间投入」，有些队伍每天都要训练。

examples.en: The club lists a five-hour weekly time commitment in its recruitment flyer.
examples.zh: 社团在招新传单上写明了每周五小时的「时间投入」。

words.enDefinition: an extra session for members who missed regular practice

examples.en: If you miss Tuesday, join the make-up practice on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 如果错过了周二，就参加周五上午的「补训」。

examples.en: The coach runs make-up practice for members returning from winter break.
examples.zh: 教练为寒假归队的成员安排了「补训」。
